findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_route, create_event, invite_members · Private data: club_in_race, event_weather, fly_route, tour_route, find_coaches, find_adventure_routes, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, publish_event, post_club_ride, add_my_race, add_my_tour · Public sink: where_is, find_clubs, find_coaches, plan_route, publish_event, post_club_ride, invite_members, add_charity_event, my_charity_team · Destructive: find_person, where_is, club_in_race, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, post_club_ride, add_my_race, add_charity_event, set_my_cause.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_route, create_event, invite_members · Private data: club_in_race, event_weather, fly_route, tour_route, find_coaches, find_adventure_routes, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, publish_event, post_club_ride, add_my_race, add_my_tour · Public sink: where_is, find_clubs, find_coaches, plan_route, publish_event, post_club_ride, invite_members, add_charity_event, my_charity_team · Destructive: find_person, where_is, club_in_race, plan_route, list_my_events, create_event, post_club_ride, add_my_race, add_charity_event, set_my_cause

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
